notes: If the connection drops just as you punch, the app now checks by itself whether your punch was saved: if it was, it shows as done; if not, it is sent again once. You only see a message when the aTAS server can't be reached at all. A punch is still never saved twice.

Punching is quicker, most of all on iPhone: the app reuses the location it found a moment ago instead of waiting for a new GPS fix, and a weak indoor fix no longer makes you wait unless your outlet only allows punches on site.
